questions.prompt: What is the Act I town called?
questions.explanation: Act I opens at the Rogue Encampment, a town within a fortress held by the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye.

questions.prompt: Charsi, who repairs your gear in the Rogue Encampment, serves which trade?
questions.explanation: Charsi is the blacksmith of the Rogue Encampment and a member of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye.

questions.prompt: Who gives the Den of Evil quest?
questions.explanation: Akara, the Priestess of the Sightless Eye, tasks you with clearing the Den of Evil.

questions.prompt: Andariel, the Maiden of Anguish, is the end boss of which act?
questions.explanation: Andariel is the final boss of Act I and one of the Lesser Evils.

questions.prompt: The Den of Evil reward includes a skill point and what else?
choices: A free Tome of Town Portal
questions.explanation: Den of Evil grants +1 skill point and one free respec of your stats and skills.

questions.prompt: Blood Raven, fought in the Burial Grounds, is what kind of enemy?
questions.explanation: Blood Raven was a Rogue of the Sightless Eye, corrupted by Andariel into a Corrupt Rogue Archer who can summon zombies.
The Countess waits at the bottom of the Forgotten Tower in the Black Marsh.

questions.prompt: The Countess is most famous among farmers for guaranteeing a drop of what?
questions.explanation: She has a 100% chance to drop 1–3 runes per kill, scaling up to Lo runes on Hell difficulty.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the Amazon's three skill trees?
questions.explanation: Shadow Disciplines belongs to the Assassin. The Amazon's trees are Bow and Crossbow, Javelin and Spear, and Passive and Magic.

questions.prompt: Andariel has a gaping -50 resistance to which element across all difficulties?
questions.explanation: Andariel's Maiden of Anguish frame burns fast in fire; she carries -50 fire resistance at every difficulty.

questions.prompt: Blood Raven was once a member of which order before Andariel's corruption?
choices: The Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye
questions.explanation: Blood Raven served in the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye (the same order Akara, Kashya, and Charsi belong to) before her fall.

questions.prompt: Which modifier does Blood Raven carry that lights up her arrows?
questions.explanation: Blood Raven carries the Fire Arrow modifier; hence the streaks of flame she draws across the Burial Grounds.
